page_title: CAG 1-1 MON | Cagliari v Monza 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+1' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' The game has come to an end for Tommaso Augello. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari).

86' Valentin Carboni (Monza) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
85' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

85' That was a nice football moment. Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Simone Scuffet guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Monza will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' Substitution. Pablo Mari (Monza) in, Andrea Carboni out.
82' Jose Machin (Monza) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
81' The corner from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is hurriedly cleared.
81' The resulting corner from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is cleared by the defence.
80' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Monza get a corner.
80' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul after Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) hacks down one of his opponents.
78' The Monza players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
77' Here is a change. Zito Luvumbo is going off and Claudio Ranieri gives the last tactical orders to Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari).
77' Substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) on for Andrea Petagna.
74' A pass from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is intercepted by Simone Scuffet and the move breaks down.
73' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Viola will be replaced by Jakub Jankto (Cagliari).
73' Edoardo Goldaniga will be replaced by Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari).
72' 6:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
70' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Patrick Ciurria (Monza) heads on.
69' Jose Machin (Monza) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
68' The Monza players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
67' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Andrea Colpani is replaced by Valentin Carboni (Monza).
67' Jose Machin (Monza) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dany Mota.
65' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 5:11.
63' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
61' 1 - 1 Gooal! Georgios Kyriakopoulos takes over corner duties. Mirko Maric (Monza) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the middle of the net. 1:1.
61' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) prepares to take a corner kick.

60' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee points to the corner flag and Monza will take a corner.
60' A lofted cross from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
59' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Andrea Petagna (Cagliari), whose header goes wide of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
57' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Patrick Ciurria (Monza) replaces Samuele Birindelli.
57' It will be a substitution. Mirko Maric (Monza) is ready to enter the pitch as Lorenzo Colombo walks off.
56' The resulting set piece from Monza is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' Andrea Colpani (Monza) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
55' Andrea Colpani (Monza) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. Monza will take a corner kick.
54' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Matteo Marchetti signals. Monza are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
52' Andrea Colpani (Monza) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

52' Dany Mota (Monza) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the bar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
50' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
50' Matteo Marchetti interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Andrea Colpani (Monza).
48' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
47' Matteo Pessina (Monza) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
46' Monza control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The whistle blows and Matteo Marchetti starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) comes close as his long-range free kick goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
44' Ball possession – 47:53.
42' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
41' The resulting corner from Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) comes to nothing.
41' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
40' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes.
39' Dany Mota (Monza) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

38' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Simone Scuffet earns his money with a fine reflex save. Now Monza have a corner.
37' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
36' Andrea Colpani (Monza) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
34' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts the ball.
33' Great teamplay by Monza as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
32' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) fires a volley towards goal, but the ball sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
30' Corner kicks – 8:3.
29' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) brings his opponent down. Matteo Marchetti has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner with a short pass.
27' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. Cagliari force a corner. They send men into the box.
26' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cagliari.
25' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Michele Di Gregorio has no trouble gathering it.
24' The resulting corner, taken by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari), comes to nothing.
23' Surely that's handball by one of the Monza players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
22' Flag up against Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
22' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) swings in a cross from the corner, but Michele Di Gregorio reads it well and gathers the ball.

21' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
19' Monza enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
17' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
15' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
14' Monza seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
13' Matteo Pessina (Monza) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
10' 1 - 0 Goal! Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
10' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

10' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Michele Di Gregorio has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
9' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) serves up a nice cross, but Simone Scuffet punches the ball away.
9' Cagliari are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
7' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
5' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
4' Monza take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' Simone Scuffet makes a difficult save to deny Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza), who attempted to score with a header from inside the box. Monza force their opponents to concede a corner.
3' Corner kick. Dany Mota (Monza) is ready to send the ball into the box.
2' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance. It will be a corner kick for Monza.
2' Monza take a short corner kick.
2' Dany Mota (Monza) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Monza are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
Cagliari will kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti will officiate today.
